{{Top|leg}}
'''Leacs''' were a type of plant native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brosi]]. They grew in thick forests and could cause injury to people travelling through them. [[Randle Clanse]] had numerous scars on her arms caused by travelling through Brosi's thick leac forests.
